async def run(items, width):
    for batch in prepared_batches:
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await asyncio.gather(*(save(item) for item in batch))
    for batch in prepare_chunks(items, width):
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await asyncio.gather(*(save(item) for item in batch))
    for start in range(len(items), 0, -width):
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await asyncio.gather(*(save(item) for item in items[start-width:start]))
    for item in unique(items):
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await asyncio.gather(save(item), notify(item))
    for start in range(0, len(items), 1):
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await asyncio.gather(save(items[start]))
